Messages.Author: Alex Broadhead
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

Coming down to the wire now, it looks as if I actually might be able
to make it to GenCon. (I'm in Chicago, so I'm at liberty to decide
such matters at the last minute...) However, I'm having a hard time
finding any actual Useful Information (TM) about its whys and
wherefors. (Yes, I have been to the WotC site - like I said, I need
Useful Info.)

So, can someone fortunate enough to have the pre-registration packet
(or whatever it is that actually lists the events) please post a reply
listing the times, costs, and availability of the VTES qualifier on
Friday and the Championships on Saturday? Also appreciated would be
info about any other VTES-related events - I've seen several mentioned
in passing in this newsgroup.

Thanks,
Alex

See the WW VTES calendar for times of the VTES events we're running there.
http://calendar.yahoo.com/vtesrep

The Thu tournament is 7:00 and $4.50
The Fri qualifier and non-qualifier parallel event (run under the
same ticket) is 2:00 and $6
The Sat championship is free to qualifiers.
The Sat parallel tournament is 2:00 and $6
